title: The $18\cdot 2^t+1$ Triangle-Maximal Series of Straight Lines
summary: Given $n$ lines in general position in the plane, how many bounded triangular faces can the arrangement have? We construct a straight-line affine arrangement of $19$ lines satisfying the conditions of the iterative construction by Bartholdi, Blanc, and Loisel, thereby obtaining an infinite series of straight-line arrangements attaining the maximum number of bounded triangles for every $n=18\cdot 2^t+1$.
